entry.title: LMC MVC-based Modules are now maintenance only
entry.summary: With the announcement from the Laminas Technical Committee to put all Laminas MVC components into maintenance-only,
entry.content:
With the announcement from the Laminas Technical Committee to put all Laminas MVC components into maintenance-only, we have decided to do the same for the LMC packages that are based on Laminas MVC.

Therefore, the following packages will be set to Maintenance-Only and no new features will be developed but they will be updated to support PHP 8.5:

PackageVersionComments
LmcUser3Version 4 will be abandoned
LmcUserDoctrineORMAll
LmcUserDoctrineMongoODMAll
LmcRbacMvcAll
LmcRbacMvcDeveloperTools1
LmcCors1Version 2 is abandoned
LmcAdminAll
LmcMail1Abandoned

New Mezzio Packages​

New packages will be developed for Mezzio as replacements for Laminas MVC based packages. These will be announced later.

entry.title: LM-Commons now supports PHP 8.4
entry.summary: PHP 8.4 support has been added to the following packages:
entry.content:
PHP 8.4 support has been added to the following packages:

  • LmcUser V3
  • LmcRbac V1
  • LmcRbac V2
  • LmcRbacMvc V3
  • LmcRbacMvc V4
  • LmcCors V1

entry.title: LmcBootstrapMenu v1.0.0. is available
entry.summary: LmcBootstrapMenu is a new LM-Commons package that provides a Bootstrap menu helper.
entry.content:
LmcBootstrapMenu is a new LM-Commons package that provides a Bootstrap menu helper.

The repository is available on GitHub LM-Commons/LmcBootstrapMenu.

It is also available on Packagist via Composer. Please see installation instructions in the README.md file in the GitHub repository.
